prompt:
Create a cinematic, photorealistic vertical split-screen café diptych showing the same stylish young woman in two surreal coffee moments, separated by a thin white divider down the center. Use a wide 3:2 canvas, ultra-realistic photography, dramatic warm golden-hour lighting, shallow depth of field, crisp foreground detail, motion-frozen liquid splashes, rich contrast, and a wide-angle close-up perspective.

Left panel: Outside a stylish European street café, the woman wears a crisp white button-up shirt with her dark hair tied in a loose messy bun. She leans toward the camera with a playful pout, holding one oversized white cappuccino cup with both hands extremely close to the lens. The cup contains latte art shaped like a white heart in tan foam. A giant caramel coffee splash erupts upward from the cup in an elegant crown and looping arcs, with many suspended droplets frozen midair. The setting includes a round marble café table in the foreground, wicker café chairs, dark arched windows reflecting warm bokeh lights, leafy greenery, and a European city street in the background.

Right panel: Inside a moody modern café or bar, the same woman wears a dark chunky knit sweater, oversized black sunglasses, small earrings, rings, and white manicured nails, with her hair in a loose messy bun. She smiles while holding one dark green ceramic cup on a matching saucer close to the camera. A vivid green matcha splash erupts from the cup like a circular crown, with many green droplets floating around her and across the table. The interior has tall black-framed windows showing a city street outside, warm pendant lights, wooden tables, a dark ceiling, and a softly blurred menu/bar area in the background.

Discrete elements to include exactly: 2 side-by-side panels; 1 thin vertical white divider; 1 woman appearing in both panels; 2 total cups, one oversized white cappuccino cup on the left and one dark green matcha cup with saucer on the right; 2 main liquid splashes, one caramel coffee splash and one green matcha splash; 2 café environments, one outdoor European café and one indoor café/bar. No text, no logos, no watermark, no extra panels.
